text:
nina: FYI deploy window tonight 23:30 UTC. We're toggling feature flag llm-fallback-v1 for staged rollout. Aim: validate fallback behavior and cost delta.

raj: ETA on ramp and pin plan?

nina: Ramp plan (20m total):
```
0-5m: 5% -> canary-web
5-10m: 25% -> canary-web + canary-api
10-20m: 100% -> all prod traffic
Pin version 4.6.0 to dedicated pool for 45m post-100%
```

luis: Noted. What are hard rollback conditions?

nina: Hard rollback triggers: sustained user error delta > 1.0% for 4m OR p95 > 1000ms for 3m OR sampled-quality-failures > 3% on eval set. Soft-backoff: if any cohort shows 0.4% 5xx for 3m drop to 5% and hold 10m.

raj: Also add cost backstop: token-cost/unit > 20% vs baseline -> cap to 50% traffic and notify finance.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: schedule confirmed by nina for 2026-03-23T23:30:00Z. Auto-rollback: enabled. Auto-pin-previous: enabled. Quiet-mode alerts: non-critical muted. Pager -> #platform-oncall.

cory: Quick test headers for smoke: `curl -H 'X-FF-LLM: llm-fallback-v1' -H 'X-Test-Cohort: canary-web' https://api.internal/llm/endpoint`

marta: Adding a manual approval gate: early-unpin requires 2 approvers from eng-sre + product. Otherwise auto-unpin only after hold period.

nina: Good. Also enabling per-cohort sampling traces and hallucination classifier counters. If hallucination-rate > 2% in any cohort -> immediate rollback.

platform-oncall: I'll watch dashboards (errors, p95, hallucination-rate, token-cost). Please @platform-oncall if auto-rollback fires so we can triage traces.

raj: Small UX ask: include rollout marker in logs so we can filter traces with `rollout_id=llm-fallback-6829`

nina: Done — deploybot will tag traces and metrics with rollout_id.

luis: Release notes stub (will PR):
- Enable llm-fallback-v1 with staged rollout and per-cohort telemetry
- Pin v4.6.0 for 45m to allow rapid rollback
- Added hallucination-rate metric and costing backstops
Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/6829

marta: Runbook changes: added soft-backoff recovery steps and manual-unpin checklist. I left a short checklist for SRE:
- verify 5xx < 0.3% post-100%
- confirm p95 delta < 250ms
- confirm sampled-quality failures < 1.5%
- check token-cost delta < 15%

nina: Ops knobs I'll flip:
- enable soft-backoff = true
- fast-unpin = false
- auto-pin-on-rollback = true (hold 30m)
- alert routing: critical -> #platform-oncall, info -> #eng-releases

cory: If we need to force a rollback, command: `deploybot rollback llm-fallback-v1 --reason "regression" --pin previous`

deploy-bot: Reminder: rolling back will auto-pin previous stable for 30m and post a summary to #eng-releases.

raj: If rollback happens, let's run a reduced canary after fixes (5% for 15m) rather than full immediate ramp.

nina: Agreed. Will coordinate follow-up canary and postmortem if needed.

platform-oncall: I'll be on watch from 23:25-00:45 UTC. Will call for paging if we hit hard thresholds.

nina: Great — rolling according to plan. Ping me if you see anything odd. :rocket:
